name: F-16 Fighting Falcon
summary: Compact single-engine multirole fighter and the most numerous fighter in the USAF inventory, flown by active, Guard and Reserve units as well as the Thunderbirds.

wings: Mid-mounted cropped-delta wing with strong leading-edge sweep
Long curved leading-edge root extensions (LERX) blending into the fuselage
Wingtip missile rails, usually carrying AIM-9 or AIM-120
engines: Distinctive smiling chin-mounted intake under the cockpit
fuselage: Blended slim fuselage with frameless bubble canopy set high and well forward
Two small ventral fins under the rear fuselage, angled outward
tail: Single tall swept vertical fin, often with a drag-chute or antenna fairing at the base
All-moving horizontal stabilizers with slight anhedral

tellTales: Gaping intake mouth under the nose — no side intakes
One engine and one vertical tail on a small, slim airframe
Bubble canopy with no frame in front of the pilot

confusedWith.howToTell: The F-16 has a single tail and a chin intake; the F-35 has twin canted tails and side-mounted intakes on a much fatter fuselage.
The F-16 has one engine and one tail; the Hornet has two engines, twin canted tails and intakes under the LERX on both sides.
The F-22 is far larger with twin canted tails, diamond-shaped wings and angular side intakes; the F-16 has a single tail and chin intake.

usCount.source: USAF F-16 fact sheet / FlightGlobal World Air Forces 2025
